name: Eshcol
title: Abraham's Amorite Allies
summary: Eshcol was an Amorite chieftain who lived near Hebron and was allied with Abraham. He was the brother of Aner and Mamre, and together with Abraham he participated in the rescue mission to free Lot from King Kedorlaomer and his allies. The Valley of Eshcol (Valley of Grapes) near Hebron was named after him.

keyEvents.title: Alliance with Abraham
keyEvents.description: Eshcol and his brothers Aner and Mamre were Amorites who made a covenant with Abraham and became his allies while he lived at the oaks of Mamre near Hebron.

keyEvents.title: Participation in the War against Kedorlaomer
keyEvents.description: When Lot was captured by King Kedorlaomer and his allied kings, Eshcol went out with Abraham and his brothers to rescue him. They pursued the enemies all the way to Dan.

keyEvents.title: The Victory over the Four Kings
keyEvents.description: Eshtekol was with Abraham when they defeated Kedorlaomer and the allied kings, and rescued Lot along with all the captives and possessions that had been taken.

keyEvents.title: Share of the War Spoils
keyEvents.description: Abraham ensured that Eshtekol, Aner, and Mamre received their rightful share of the war spoils after the victory, even though Abraham himself kept nothing for himself.

keyEvents.title: The Valley of Eshkol
keyEvents.description: The valley near Hebron was called the Valley of Eshkol (Valley of the Cluster). Later, when Moses sent spies into Canaan, they cut a cluster of grapes there, and the place was named after Eshtekol.
